empty_mask_policy.case_both_empty: 0.0 mm (both prediction and ground truth contain 0 voxels; true negative boundary alignment)
empty_mask_policy.case_one_empty: Volume Euclidean diagonal penalty in mm: sqrt(sum((dim_i * spacing_i)^2)) (complete false positive or false negative)
empty_mask_policy.case_both_nonempty: 95th percentile Euclidean surface distance in physical millimeters computed via MONAI compute_hausdorff_distance
empty_mask_policy.error_handling: Technical calculation failures on non-empty masks raise explicit RuntimeError and are never disguised as penalties
